map.综合Valsalva动作、鼓室压图、声反射及主观症状，评估咽鼓管开放程度与功能障: Assesses eustachian tube patency and grades dysfunction by combining the Valsalva manoeuvre, tympanometry, acoustic reflexes and subjective symptoms.
map.咽鼓管功能评分 = 各探测项得分之和（满分 18）− 症状项数（每项 −1，最多: Eustachian tube function score = the sum of the probe item scores (out of 18) − the number of symptom items (−1 each, up to −5); 16 or above is grade 0 normal, 12–16 is grade I mild, 8–12 is grade II, and lower is grade III/IV dysfunction.
map.鼓膜运动情况（耳窥镜下观察）: Tympanic membrane movement (observed with an otoscope)
map.耳内有气流声/\"噗\"声: Airflow or a "pop" sound in the ear
map.耳内胀满感: Sensation of fullness in the ear
map.4. Toynbee试验（捏鼻吞咽）: 4. Toynbee test (swallowing with the nose pinched)
map.主要症状（可多选影响加权）: Main symptoms (multiple selections affect the weighting)
map.咽鼓管功能正常，无需处理: Normal eustachian tube function, no treatment needed
map.药物+咽鼓管吹张，评估手术: Medication plus tube inflation, consider surgery
map.建议鼓室置管或咽鼓管球囊扩张: Tympanostomy tube insertion or balloon dilation recommended
map.需手术干预，评估病因: Surgical intervention needed, evaluate the cause
map.本评估器综合Valsalva动作、鼓室压图、声反射、Toynbee试验及临床症状: This assessor scores eustachian tube function quantitatively from the Valsalva manoeuvre, tympanogram, acoustic reflexes, Toynbee test and clinical symptoms, out of a total of 18 points. A higher score means better tubal opening function. The Valsalva manoeuvre is the most common clinical screening method and tympanometry is an important objective assessment tool.
map.📚 深度解析：咽鼓管(Valsalva)开放程度评估器: 📚 In-depth Analysis: Eustachian Tube (Valsalva) Patency Assessor
map.感冒后耳闷、听力下降，用 Valsalva 动作评估咽鼓管能否开放、耳闷是否缓解: After a cold, with ear fullness and hearing loss, use the Valsalva manoeuvre to see whether the tube can open and whether the fullness eases.
map.飞行/潜水升降压时耳痛，评估咽鼓管调节能力，指导吞咽咀嚼等调压。: For ear pain during pressure changes when flying or diving, assess the tube's regulatory ability and guide pressure-equalising actions such as swallowing and chewing.
map.长期耳闷伴自声过强，排查咽鼓管异常开放（腭咽肌松弛）。: For long-standing ear fullness with autophony, check for a patulous eustachian tube (lax palatopharyngeal muscles).
map.患者捏鼻鼓气后闻及耳内“POP”声、耳闷缓解，提示咽鼓管可开放，功能基本正常；若: The patient hears a "POP" in the ear after blowing with the nose pinched and the fullness eases, showing the tube can open and function is essentially normal; if repeated inflation brings no relief and the eardrum is retracted, obstructive dysfunction is indicated.
map.Valsalva 动作怎么做？: How is the Valsalva manoeuvre performed?
map.捏紧鼻翼、闭口用力呼气使气流经咽鼓管进入中耳，正常可感耳闷缓解或弹响；高血压、心: Pinch the nostrils, close the mouth and exhale forcefully so air passes through the tube into the middle ear; normally the fullness eases or a click is heard. Use with caution in patients with hypertension or heart failure.
map.咽鼓管异常开放与阻塞如何区分？: How do you distinguish a patulous tube from an obstructed one?
map.阻塞为开放不足（耳闷、听力下降、鼓膜内陷）；异常开放为闭合不全（自声过强、耳内气: Obstruction means insufficient opening (ear fullness, hearing loss, retracted eardrum), while patulous means incomplete closure (autophony, airflow sounds in the ear, fullness while speaking). The two call for opposite management.
